value: 50% exemption for pay above €55,000 (17 years); 20% exemption up to €8,550 (7 years); 25% repatriation exemption up to €25,000 (7 years, also for business profits)
note: Self-employed persons pay social insurance quarterly on the weekly insurable income of their occupational category; GHS is due on actual profits.
source_title: Tax Department: Απαλλαγή 50% για πρώτη εργοδότηση στη Δημοκρατία (άρθρα 8(23) και 8(23Α)); Απαλλαγή 20% (ή €8.550) για πρώτη εργοδότηση (άρθρα 8(21) και 8(21Α)); Απαλλαγή 25% (Σχέδιο Επαναπατρισμού Ταλέντων, άρθρο 8(21Β))

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Non-dom status
value: No special defence contribution for non-domiciled residents; deemed domicile after 17 of 20 years, extendable twice by €250,000 per five years
note: Self-employed persons pay social insurance quarterly on the weekly insurable income of their occupational category; GHS is due on actual profits.
source_title: Tax Department: Tax Residency/Domicility

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Tax residence
value: More than 183 days in Cyprus, or the 60-day rule (at least 60 days, work or business and a home in Cyprus, not over 183 days in another country)
note: Self-employed persons pay social insurance quarterly on the weekly insurable income of their occupational category; GHS is due on actual profits.
source_title: Tax Department: Tax Residency/Domicility
